summary: Tested My Money (Individual dashboard) — backend pytest 8/8 passing; frontend full E2E flow verified for Individual user (page loads, profile edit + persist, asset/liability CRUD, allocation pie, save toast, quick links). Dashboard 'Your Money' section gating verified (visible for Individual, hidden for Advisor & non-admin advisor). RoleGate /my-money correctly blocks non-admin advisors; admins bypass by design.

design_issues.screen: MyMoney - Net Worth Allocation pie chart
issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs repeated width(-1) height(-1) warnings on initial render; chart still renders visually but inside a hidden-on-first-paint card likely triggers it. Cosmetic console noise.

When net_worth is negative (liabilities > assets) the readiness-pct can render as a negative number e.g. '-32%'. Consider clamping pct to 0 in backend (currently min(ratio*100, 999) without max(0, …)).

action_items: (Optional) Clamp retirement_readiness.pct to max(0, …) in /app/backend/routes/my_money.py so negative net worth doesn't display as -32%.
(Optional) Suppress Recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings by setting an explicit min-height on the chart container or guarding render until container measured.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleGate admin bypass is documented in component — advisor-admin users (e.g. pierrelouisvdm@gmail.com is_admin=true) WILL access /my-money. Confirmed intentional via code comment.
GET /me/financial/profile returns 200 with default profile when none exists — clean behaviour, no need for the FE to handle 404.
RA personal_cap correctly falls back to RA_DEDUCTION_CAP (350k) when annual_income is missing — verified by test_dashboard_insufficient_data.
Mongo _id is properly excluded via projection ({'_id': 0, 'user_id': 0}) — no ObjectId leakage.
User isolation enforced via {user_id: current_user['id']} filter — tested with two distinct users.

seed_data_creation: Multiple ephemeral users created (individual + advisor) during pytest and Playwright runs. Their financial profiles persist in user_financial_profiles collection — harmless test data prefixed with mm_*.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_my_money.py covers auth, defaults, PUT+GET round-trip, dashboard math (TFSA/RA caps, net_worth, allocation, readiness), insufficient-data fallback and user isolation. FE testing seeded auth via localStorage (advisorypro_token + advisorypro_user) to bypass the AuthPage form. Admin role (is_admin=true) bypasses RoleGate by design; to negative-test a role gate, register a fresh advisor (or individual) user — they will not have is_admin.
